description: CRASH-CONTROL: an interrupt at an arbitrary point inside a statement (a freeze, then a kill, instead of a kill at a call boundary). Writer a opens the idx fixture shared and runs INSERT INTO T (ID, N, S, M) SELECT ID + 10000, N + 100000, S, M FROM T (dbFailOnError); b suspends a 60 ms after the start signal (a had not returned), records the database and lock files (size, hash, kept), kills the frozen a, waits 0.5 s, freezes the files again (kept), opens with DAO (Errors) and reads COUNT(*), SUM(N), an IX_N walk and memo lengths, then runs CompactDatabase of a copy into scratch-compacted-early.accdb and reads it. Asks what ACE-first and Compact-first openers find after a mid-statement freeze-and-kill: file size, errors, repair requests, row counts, index/data agreement.
retentionNote: Designed kill: participant b suspends participant a with SuspendParticipant at the probe's named point, then ends it with KillParticipant (TerminateProcess, exit 0xDEAD), as b's capture records; a seals Uncertain by design and b's answers are the evidence.
